title: Product List with TrackBy
description: Render a list of products with index, even/odd row styling, and performance‑optimised trackBy.
problemStatement:
Build a product list component that displays an array of products efficiently.

**Requirements:**
1. Define a `Product` interface (or class) with `id`, `name`, and `price`.
2. In the component, create an array of at least 5 products.
3. Use `*ngFor` to render the list in a `<ul>`.
4. Show the product index (1‑based) and name.
5. Apply a light gray background to even rows using `[style.background]` and the `even` local variable.
6. Implement a `trackBy` function that returns `product.id`.
7. Add a button “Shuffle” that replaces the array with a new one (same items but different order) to verify trackBy is working (no DOM flicker).
hints: Interface: `export interface Product { id: number; name: string; price: number; }`
trackBy method signature: `trackById(index: number, product: Product): number { return product.id; }`
Use `*ngFor="let product of products; let i = index; let isEven = even; trackBy: trackById"`
expectedOutput: Products displayed with alternating row colors. Clicking Shuffle reorders items quickly (Angular reuses DOM elements).
